subject: SIG evidence: Request for SOC 2 / pen test / ISO artifacts
messages:
From: James Porter <james.porter@novahealth.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: lena.ortiz@novahealth.io
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request: SOC 2, pen test, ISO statements

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of NovaHealth's procurement checklist (SIG v2.1), our security team needs the following artifacts to complete risk review: 
- Latest SOC 2 report (redacted OK)
- Executive summary of the most recent third-party penetration test
- ISO/management system statements (ISO 27001 or similar)
- Short security overview deck we can present to the compliance committee

Can you confirm what you can provide today vs. what will take a couple of days? We prefer a secure link to download artifacts rather than email attachments.

Appreciate it — we are on a 2-week review cadence and want to close this by July 12.

Regards,
James Porter
Director, Information Security
NovaHealth

Short answer: we can provide redacted SOC 2, a pen test executive summary, an ISO 27001 statement, and our high-level security deck. I will coordinate delivery via a shared Drive folder and send access links.

2) Monica will review redactions and confirm no customer-identifying info remains.
3) By tomorrow EOD PT we'll send the Drive link and a checklist indicating which SIG questions are covered by each artifact.

If you need the SIG spreadsheet filled in directly, let me know — we can either attach the completed CSV or walk through the mapping on a quick call.

Next steps:

- If NovaHealth requires a DPA addendum or specific redaction level, please confirm.

Best,
Soojin Lee
